error_troubleshooting_modal.title: Troubleshooting Help

passkey_overview.title: About Passkeys
passkey_overview.description: Passkeys are a more secure and convenient way to sign in. They use your device's biometric authentication (fingerprint, face recognition) or PIN.
passkey_overview.benefit2: No passwords to remember or lose
passkey_overview.benefit3: Encrypted and stored only on your device

passkey_faq.question1: What if I accidentally cancelled the request?
passkey_faq.answer1: Simply click the 'Retry' button to restart the authentication process.
passkey_faq.question2: Why is my device not showing the biometric prompt?
passkey_faq.answer2: Ensure your device screen is unlocked and you haven't disabled biometric authentication in your system settings.
passkey_faq.question3: What if I haven't set up biometrics yet?
passkey_faq.answer3: You can usually use your device's screen lock PIN or pattern as a fallback, or set up a fingerprint/face recognition in your device settings.
passkey_faq.question4: Are there specific browser permissions needed?
passkey_faq.answer4: Some browsers may require permission to access security keys. Check your browser settings if you're experiencing issues.
passkey_faq.answer5: Most modern devices and browsers support passkeys. If you're on an older system, you may need to update your software.
passkey_faq.question6: The request timed out. What should I do?
passkey_faq.answer6: Authentication requests have a time limit. If it expires, please try again.

error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_description: If you're having trouble with fingerprint or face recognition:
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point1: Ensure your sensor is clean and dry.
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point2: Try using your device PIN if biometrics fail multiple times.
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point3: Restart your device if the biometric system seems unresponsive.
error_troubleshooting_modal.still_need_help_description: If none of the above solutions work, please contact our support team for further assistance.

wallet_help_modal.title: Your Bitcoin Wallet
wallet_help_modal.hero_description: Send and receive Bitcoin and USDT on RGB. Lightning is included for bitcoin. You open this wallet with your passkey.
wallet_help_modal.multi_network_description: One wallet: Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, and Lightning. You do not connect another network.
wallet_help_modal.security_description: You control your keys. BitTasker never holds your funds - only you can move your Bitcoin.
wallet_help_modal.lightning_description: Instant Bitcoin payments with the Lightning Network. No waits, no delays, just peer-to-peer speed.
wallet_help_modal.escrow_description: The hirer locks the amount here. They pay the invoice after they approve the work.
wallet_help_modal.step1_description: Sign up with a passkey. The same passkey opens this wallet. There is no swap between networks.
wallet_help_modal.step2_description: Your funds are protected by advanced cryptography. Only you and the other party can release payments.
wallet_help_modal.step3_description: Send Bitcoin or USDT, pay a Lightning invoice, or buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer to your own address.
wallet_help_modal.benefits_description: Traditional platforms hold your money and charge fees. BitTasker gives you control with Bitcoin security and Lightning speed.
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_description: USDT on RGB is the dollar balance in this wallet. It is not a separate coin you bridge in from another network.
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_security_desc: You hold it in the wallet you open with your passkey
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_contracts_desc: A hirer can lock USDT on RGB until they approve the work
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_settlement_desc: Paying the invoice usually takes a few minutes
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_fees_desc: Network fees are separate from BitTasker's service fee
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_peg_desc: Card purchases pay bitcoin to your own address, not into BitTasker
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_title: Can I buy bitcoin with a card?
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_description: Yes. Buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer. The provider takes the card and any identity check. The bitcoin is paid to your own address. BitTasker does not see the card.
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_settlement_desc: The bitcoin arrives at your address
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_assets_desc: USDT on RGB stays in this wallet. A card purchase sends Bitcoin, not those dollars
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_peg_desc: BitTasker does not hold the coins
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_fees_desc: The provider shows its own fee before you continue
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_description: Yes. This wallet can send and receive bitcoin over Lightning. USDT on RGB does not need a Lightning channel.
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_deposits_desc: Send Lightning payments that are instantly available
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_fees_desc: Pay minimal fees for Lightning transactions
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_conversion_desc: Lightning bitcoin is not converted into another coin for escrow
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_withdrawals_desc: You can pay a Lightning invoice from this wallet
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_adoption_desc: Lightning here is part of the same wallet
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_description: The hirer locks Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning. The worker does the work. The hirer approves it. The worker requests payment. The hirer pays that invoice.
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_channels_desc: Messages open only after escrow is formed
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_time_desc: Nothing is paid on a timer
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_contracts_desc: If you disagree, cancel while the contract is open and unpaid
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_multisig_desc: Reviews open only after the invoice is paid
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_risks_desc: BitTasker cannot spend the locked amount

secure_payment_contract_modal.title: Secure Payment Contract
secure_payment_contract_modal.hero_title: How Your Secure Payment Contract Works
secure_payment_contract_modal.hero_description: The hirer locks Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning in escrow. Only the hirer pays it out, after they approve the work.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_locked: **Locked:** The amount stays in escrow until you approve the work and pay the invoice.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_review: **Approval:** After the work is submitted, you approve it. Waiting does not pay anyone.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_grace: **Cancel:** You can cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_dispute: **Disagreement:** Do not pay the invoice. There is no automatic refund and no outside judge.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_cancel: **Open contracts:** Cancel is on the contract page until the invoice is paid.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_no_show: **No delivery:** Cancel the open contract. A timer will not refund you.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_guaranteed: **Payment:** After approval, request payment. The hirer pays that invoice, usually within a few minutes.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_upfront: **Amount:** The locked amount is the agreed price.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_dispute: **Messages:** They open only after escrow is formed, and only with the hirer.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_refund: **Refund:** A refund is a separate payment you both agree. It is not automatic.
secure_payment_contract_modal.platform_fees_both: **Fees:** BitTasker charges a service fee when a task is completed. Bitcoin and Lightning network fees are separate, and BitTasker does not keep them.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_24h: **Before payment:** Either side can cancel an open, unpaid contract.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_1h: **No grace timer:** Cancel does not depend on a one-hour window.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_7d: **No review timer:** The hirer pays only after they approve.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_14d: **No refund timer:** Disagreement does not refund anyone automatically.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_propose: **Talk first:** Use the bid before escrow, and messages after escrow is formed.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_agree: **Agree:** Pay the invoice only when the work is acceptable.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_escalate: **No escalation:** BitTasker does not decide the split.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_grace: **Cancel:** Available while the contract is open and unpaid.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_cancellation: **After payment:** You cannot undo a paid invoice.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_review: **Approval:** The hirer reviews the work, then pays. There is no 7-day release.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_dispute: **Disagreement:** Cancel or withhold payment. There is no 14-day refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step1: **Step 1:** Do not pay the invoice if the work is not acceptable.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step2: **Step 2:** Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step3: **Step 3:** Talk in the bid, or in messages after escrow is formed.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step4: **Step 4:** There is no outside judge and no automatic refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.cancellation_tasker: **Hirer:** Can cancel while the contract is open and unpaid.
secure_payment_contract_modal.cancellation_taskee: **Worker:** Can cancel an open, unpaid contract as well.
